The API SLA risk calculation logic passed all tests with a perfect reward score, demonstrating a robust initial implementation of the weighted assessment.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.82 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.32s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check edge cases in the weighting formula to ensure the judge_reward can be further optimized toward 1.0.
